*COMMAND DOCS
 You can use the following commands to perform actions and queries. Use exactly one command per response, with the syntax !commandName(params).

stop: Stop all current actions (movement, mining, combat, following).

stfu: Stop chatting and self-narration, but continue current actions.

unshut: Resume chatting and self-narration after stfu.

restart: Restart the agent process (clean shutdown).

clearChat: Clear the conversation history.

stats: Report current health, food, position, gamemode, biome, time, weather, and nearby players.

inventory: List all items in the bot's inventory with counts.

goal: Report the current pathfinding goal, if any.

entities: List nearby players and entities with positions and types.

nearbyBlocks: List block types near the bot.

craftable: List all items craftable with current inventory.

help: List all available commands.

modes: Show all available behavior modes and their status.

moveTo: Move the bot to the given coordinates.
  Params:
    x: (float) X coordinate
    y: (float) Y coordinate
    z: (float) Z coordinate

goToPlayer: Navigate to the given player.
  Params:
    player_name: (string) Player name to go to
    closeness: (float) How close to get (default 3)

followPlayer: Continuously follow a player.
  Params:
    player_name: (string) Player name to follow
    follow_dist: (float) Following distance (default 4)

goToCoordinates: Move to specific x, y, z coordinates.
  Params:
    x: (float) X coordinate
    y: (float) Y coordinate
    z: (float) Z coordinate
    closeness: (float) How close to get (default 2)

searchForBlock: Find and navigate to the nearest block of the given type.
  Params:
    block_type: (string) Block type, e.g. oak_log
    search_range: (float) Search radius (default 64)

searchForEntity: Find and navigate to the nearest entity of the given type.
  Params:
    entity_type: (string) Entity type, e.g. cow
    search_range: (float) Search radius (default 64)

moveAway: Move in a random direction by the given distance.
  Params:
    distance: (float) Distance to move (default 16)

goToBed: Find the nearest bed and sleep in it.

goToSurface: Navigate upward to the surface.

digDown: Dig straight down, stopping at lava/water/bedrock.
  Params:
    distance: (int) Max distance to dig (default 10)

stay: Stay in place. Pauses all modes.
  Params:
    seconds: (int) Seconds to stay (-1 = indefinite)

attack: Attack and kill the nearest entity of the given type. Works on hostile mobs (zombie, skeleton, creeper) AND on passive mobs you need to harvest (sheep for wool, cow for leather/beef, chicken for feathers/meat, pig for pork). Use this whenever you need a resource that drops from a mob — do NOT keep calling searchForEntity if the target is already nearby.
  Params:
    entity_type: (string) Entity type, e.g. zombie, sheep, cow, chicken, pig

attackPlayer: Attack a specific player until they die or flee.
  Params:
    player_name: (string) Player name to attack

equip: Equip an item to the given body slot.
  Params:
    item_name: (string) Item to equip, e.g. diamond_sword

consume: Eat or drink the given item.
  Params:
    item_name: (string) Item to consume, e.g. cooked_beef

discard: Discard items from inventory.
  Params:
    item_name: (string) Item to discard
    num: (int) Number to discard (-1 = all)

givePlayer: Navigate to a player and give them items.
  Params:
    player_name: (string) Player to give to
    item_name: (string) Item to give
    num: (int) Number to give (default 1)

placeHere: Place a block from inventory at the current position.
  Params:
    block_type: (string) Block type to place

activateBlock: Right-click / activate the nearest block of the given type.
  Params:
    block_type: (string) Block type, e.g. lever

collectBlocks: Mine and collect blocks of the specified type.
  Params:
    block_type: (string) Block type, e.g. oak_log
    count: (int) Number to collect

useOn: Use a tool on a target entity or block.
  Params:
    tool_name: (string) Tool to use, e.g. bucket
    target: (string) Target entity/block or 'nothing'/'hand'

viewChest: Show contents of the nearest chest.

putInChest: Store items in the nearest chest.
  Params:
    item_name: (string) Item to store
    num: (int) Number to store (-1 = all)

takeFromChest: Take items from the nearest chest.
  Params:
    item_name: (string) Item to take
    num: (int) Number to take (-1 = all)

craftRecipe: Craft a recipe using available materials. Automatically detects nearby crafting tables and uses them. If no table is nearby but one is in inventory, places it, crafts, then picks it back up. Some recipes (beds, tools, armor) require a placed crafting table. Always use getCraftingPlan before crafting complex items.
  Params:
    recipe_name: (string) Item to craft, e.g. stick
    num: (int) Number to craft (default 1)

smeltItem: Smelt items in a furnace. Requires a furnace nearby and fuel + input items in inventory.
  Params:
    item_name: (string) Item to smelt, e.g. raw_iron
    num: (int) Number to smelt (default 1)

clearFurnace: Clear all items from the nearest furnace.

showVillagerTrades: Show trades for a villager by entity ID.
  Params:
    villager_id: (int) Villager entity ID

tradeWithVillager: Execute a trade with a villager.
  Params:
    villager_id: (int) Villager entity ID
    trade_index: (int) Trade number (1-based)
    count: (int) Number of trades to execute

lookAtPlayer: Look at a player or in the same direction as a player.
  Params:
    player_name: (string) Player to look at

lookAtPosition: Look at specific coordinates.
  Params:
    x: (float) X coordinate
    y: (float) Y coordinate
    z: (float) Z coordinate

setMode: Enable or disable a behavior mode.
  Params:
    mode_name: (string) Mode name
    on: (bool) True to enable, False to disable

setGoal: Set a goal message for persistent self-prompting.
  Params:
    self_prompt: (string) Goal message for self-prompting

endGoal: End the current goal and stop self-prompting.

newAction: Generate and run a one-off JavaScript Mineflayer action when built-in commands are not expressive enough.
  Params:
    code_prompt: (string) Natural language description of the custom action to code.

pickupNearbyItems: Pick up all nearby dropped items on the ground.
  Params:
    distance: (float) Pickup radius (default 8)

tillAndSow: Till the ground at coordinates and optionally plant seeds.
  Params:
    x: (float) X coordinate to till
    y: (float) Y coordinate to till
    z: (float) Z coordinate to till
    seed_type: (string) Seed type to plant, e.g. wheat_seeds (optional)

useDoor: Open a door, walk through it, and close it.
  Params:
    x: (float) X coordinate of door (optional, finds nearest)
    y: (float) Y coordinate of door (optional)
    z: (float) Z coordinate of door (optional)

getCraftingPlan: Get a comprehensive crafting plan for a target item. Shows required ingredients with exact quantities, what you already have, and what you still need to gather. Always use this before crafting complex items to know which intermediate steps are needed.
  Params:
    target_item: (string) The item to craft, e.g. diamond_sword
    quantity: (int) Quantity to craft (default 1)

searchWiki: Search the Minecraft Wiki for info about an item, block, or mechanic.
  Params:
    query: (string) The search query, e.g. 'enchanting table'

startConversation: Start a conversation with another player.
  Params:
    player_name: (string) Player to talk to
    message: (string) Message to send

endConversation: End the current conversation.
  Params:
    player_name: (string) Player to stop talking to
